ShortDescription.Value: Network editing tools: connections, curves, loops, slopes and node editing

Publish.LongDescription:
Port of the Network Multitool for Cities: Skylines. Seven modes to edit roads and rails:
* Add node: split a segment with a new node * Remove node: remove a node and merge its segments * Split node: split a node into several along its segments * Slope: give a chain of nodes a constant slope * Loop: build a loop or arc between two segments * Connection: connect two segments with two arcs * Curve: connect two segments with a smooth curve
